description: Hi! We are a team looking for people who can bring big ideas to the table and are able to listen to others when providing their own ideas. We have worked before with the proposed game engine and hope to be able to challange ourselves.
summary: We developed an interactive game in Roblox that simulates each step of designing a science space mission. The player can decide on mission objectives depending on their scenario, design their spacecraft, choose the scientific tools required for the mission, manage a budget, administer the payload, communicate between roles, and determine orbital constraints. After launching the mission, the player or players will receive feedback based on their decisions. This game will help inexperienced engineers and students learn about each step, how each section interconnects, and how important each role is for a successful mission.
details:
Our project is a Roblox game that simulates the design process leading up to a scientific space mission. It supports one to four players, each taking on one of four roles based in a dedicated room:

  • Physicist (Simulation Room): Completes minigames to work out the spacecraft’s velocity, trajectory, and orbital requirements, then sends the results to the spacecraft station. We searched for real information in velocity, trajectory and orbital requierements for the real specific spacecraft used for the mission selected.
  • Scientist (Science Lab): Chooses scientific instruments that fit the mission’s goals and passes the requirements to the spacecraft station. For each mission, we investigated actions and tools requiered to achive the mission's objective.
  • Spacecraft Engineer (Spacecraft Station): Uses information from the other rooms to build the spacecraft, selecting the engines, hull, payload bay, and nosecone needed to reach the target orbit. All of the information was taken from the NASA database and based in real missions.
  • Resource Manager (Monitoring Room): Coordinates communication between stages, keeps track of the budget, mass, and fuel, and launches the mission once everything is ready.

In single-player mode, one player takes on all four roles, moving between rooms to collect the information needed at each stage. Time limits are adjusted to make the solo experience manageable. After launch, the game evaluates the player’s decisions and provides feedback on the mission’s performance.

The game gives students and aspiring engineers a chance to explore how a real space mission is designed. It connects disciplines that are often taught separately, showing how aerospace engineering relies on teamwork and ongoing communication across different fields.

We built the game in Roblox Studio using Luau. Gemini AI helped us turn our initial sketches of the rooms and game mechanics into detailed designs for Roblox, while Gemini AI, Codex and Claude both assisted with writing the game’s code.
